info.name: A97 Infinity API

item.name: Auth
item.description: Authentication endpoints for login and registration. No authentication required.

request.description: Authenticate a user and receive a Bearer token. The token is automatically saved to the {{token}} collection variable via the test script.

response.name: Login - Validation Error

request.description: Register a new owner account. Rules: name (required, string, max:255), email (required, email, unique:users), password (required, min:8). The token is automatically saved to the {{token}} collection variable via the test script.

response.name: Register Owner - Validation Error

item.name: Properties
item.description: Admin endpoints for managing properties including CRUD, status updates, and media management.

request.description:
List all properties with optional filters and pagination.

Available filters:
- filter[name]: partial match on property name
- filter[project_id]: exact match on project ID
- filter[phase_id]: exact match on phase ID
- filter[address]: partial match on address
- filter[attributes.name]: partial match on attribute name

Available includes: city, propertyType, attributes, project
Available sorts: id, name (prefix with - for descending)

Requires admin authentication.

response.name: Success (200)

request.description:
Create a new property.

Rules:
- name: required, array with ar/en translations
- attributes_ids: nullable, array of attribute IDs
- city_id: required, exists:cities
- order_id: nullable, exists:orders
- property_type_id: required, exists:property_types
- project_id: nullable, exists:projects
- phase_id: nullable, exists:phases
- latitude: nullable, numeric
- longitude: nullable, numeric

Requires admin authentication.

response.name: Success (200)
Validation Error (422)

variable.description: The ID of the property

request.description:
Get a single property with all related data.

Loads: city (with state and country), attributes, project (with developer and phases), propertyType.

Requires admin authentication.

response.name: Success (200)
